title: Canonical finite trace determined by degree-one point classes
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field and let $C/k$ be a smooth proper connected curve [def-sc-curves]. Let $\ell$ be a prime distinct from $\operatorname{char}k$ and let $n\geq1$. For each closed point $P$, use the actual divisor line bundle $\mathcal O_C(P)$ [def-sc-divisor]; its Picard class [def-sc-picard-group] may equivalently be constructed as the dual of the ideal sheaf of $P$. Define the canonical degree-normalized trace on ordinary cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]
$$\operatorname{tr}_{C,n}:H^2(C,\mu_{\ell^n})\longrightarrow \mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$$
as the unique additive homomorphism taking every class $\delta(\mathcal O_C(P))$ to $1$, where $\delta$ is the existing Kummer boundary [def-sc-kummer-sequence] under the canonical $\operatorname{Pic}(C)\simeq H^1(C,\mathbf G_m)$ identification. Such a homomorphism exists and is unique. The normalization holds for every proof that $\ell^n$ is a unit on $C$; the map is independent of that proof. Equivalently, this is degree modulo $\ell^n$ on the Kummer quotient $\operatorname{Pic}(C)/\ell^n$.

source.place: Proposition 14.2, Proposition 14.5 and Remark 14.6: degree-normalized trace and its value on point classes.
